messages.subject: [Ipmpack-users] Help for a new user
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am a graduate student and new to IPMpack. I have questions regarding how
to track individuals for multiple years in IPMpack. In the vignette there
is a column for size and sizeNext, but what about years n+2, n+3, n+4...,
n+10? How do I represent the same individual over many consecutive years?

Thanks,
-- 
Lisa Dowling


M.S. Candidate
School of Forestry
Northern Arizona University
